records.caption: The image shows two young men standing in a garden. They are both wearing casual clothes and appear to be engaged in a conversation. The man on the left is wearing a blue t-shirt and jeans, while the man in the middle is wearing black pants. They both have their arms around each other and are looking at something in the distance. The garden is well-manicured with green bushes and shrubs on both sides. In the background, there is a white gate with a circular design. The sky is blue and the overall atmosphere of the image is peaceful and serene.
references: Two young guys with shaggy hair look at their hands while hanging out in the yard.
